evidence: Titanium tetrachloride (TiCl4) and titanium tetra-isopropoxide (Ti(OiPr)4) were used as titanium precursors. Lithium tert-butoxide (LiO tBu) was applied as the lithium source and water was used as the oxygen source for all metal precursors. Nitrogen (99.999% N2) was used as a carrier and purging gas.
